title: Single command execute to one information object
purpose: Cover a control-direction command path using C_SC_NA_1 with a single IOA and a compact command qualifier, distinct from interrogation and setup traffic.
expected_behavior: Server parses the single-command ASDU and either acknowledges or routes it to command handling logic without transport or parser failure.
constraints_preserved: APCI I-frame length 0x0e matches 4-byte control field plus 10-byte ASDU
TypeID 45 matches C_SC_NA_1 from supplied function-code source
VSQ declares one object and exactly one IOA/payload is present
Common address and IOA fields are kept fixed-width under conservative 104 assumptions
issue_safety_notes: Safe valid control-path seed; no oversized VSQ, truncated IOA, or copied issue bytes.
